card.line: Makkedah was a Canaanite royal city in the plains of Judah, where five kings hid in a cave and where Joshua won a key victory.

moments.title: Five kings hide in the cave
moments.text: After the battle at Gibeon, the five kings who fled were found hiding in a cave at Makkedah. Joshua had large stones rolled against the cave's mouth and men posted to guard it.

moments.title: Joshua's camp at Makkedah
moments.text: The army came back safely to Joshua at Makkedah, and no one dared to speak a word against the Israelites.

moments.title: The kings are brought out
moments.text: Joshua had the five kings brought out of the cave. He told his commanders to put their feet on the kings' necks and said, "Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all the enemies you fight." The kings were then put to death and their bodies were thrown into the cave.

moments.title: The city is captured
moments.text: On that same day Joshua captured Makkedah and its king. Then he and all Israel moved on to fight against Libnah.
